reconstructed_captions.20: A hand applies adhesive to the edge of a black leather piece.
reconstructed_captions.21: A second piece of leather is carefully placed on top, aligning the edges.
reconstructed_captions.22: A wing divider tool is used to scribe a straight stitching guideline.
reconstructed_captions.23: A close-up view of the wing divider creating a groove along the leather's edge.
reconstructed_captions.24: A hand positions a stitching chisel on the scribed guideline.
reconstructed_captions.25: A mallet is used to hammer the chisel, punching a row of stitching holes.
reconstructed_captions.26: The leather piece is shown clamped in a stitching pony for sewing.
reconstructed_captions.27: A hand begins saddle stitching with two needles and a waxed thread.
reconstructed_captions.28: A close-up shows the needles passing through the same hole from opposite sides.
reconstructed_captions.29: The thread is pulled taut after each stitch to create a strong seam.
reconstructed_captions.30: The stitching progresses steadily along the edge of the leather piece.
reconstructed_captions.31: The final stitches are backstitched to secure the thread.
